changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Endpoint') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[Endpoint]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ServiceID] [int] NOT NULL, [UriPrefix] [varchar](100) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [ItemNode] [varchar](50) CONSTRAINT [DF_ApiEndpoint_ItemNode] DEFAULT ('item') NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Api_Endpoint] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Endpoint_Service') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[Endpoint] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Endpoint_Service] FOREIGN KEY([ServiceID]) REFERENCES [api].[Service] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [api].[Endpoint] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Endpoint_Service] END
